'''Iggy''' was a [[IG-97 battle droid|IG-97]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] who rose to prominence on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Working with [[Gizman|Big Gizz]], [[Spiker]], [[Onoh]], and [[Klepti B'ay]], the group was able to destroy a rogue [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark trooper]].
